relations.evidence: At 17, Hercus won a scholarship to St Anne's College, Oxford, where she graduated with a bachelor's degree in Oriental Studies in 1946, followed by an M.A.

relations.subject: Luise Anna Hercus
relations.evidence: In 1948, she was appointed tutor and lecturer at St Anne's College, a position she held until 1954, when she emigrated to Australia.

relations.subject: Luise Anna Hercus

relations.evidence: After 1969, she took up an appointment as senior lecturer, and then reader, in Sanskrit, in the Department of South Asian and Buddhist Studies at the Australian National University, Canberra.
